examples.sentence: 改革开放以来，中国发生了巨大的变化。
examples.romanization: gǎigékāifàng yǐlái， Zhōngguó fāshēng le jùdà de biànhuà。
examples.translation: Since the reform and opening up, China has undergone tremendous changes.

examples.sentence: 我想买一套不临街的房子，这样不会太吵。
examples.romanization: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yītào bù línjiē de fángzi， zhèyàng bùhuì tài chǎo。
examples.translation: I want to buy a house that is not adjacent to a street, so it won't be too noisy.

examples.sentence: 临走那天，父亲从老家赶来送我们。
examples.romanization: línzǒu nàtiān， fùqīn cóng lǎojiā gǎnlái sòng wǒmen。
examples.translation: On the day (just before) he left, my father came to us from my hometown.

examples.sentence: 我们回来时，立刻感受到了家的温暖。
examples.romanization: wǒmen huílai shí， lìkè gǎnshòu dàoliǎo jiāde wēnnuǎn。
examples.translation: When we came back, we immediately felt the warmth of home.

examples.sentence: 汉语技能教学包括听、说、读、写四个方面。
examples.romanization: Hànyǔ jìnéng jiàoxué bāokuò tīng、 shuō、 dú、 xiě sì gè fāngmiàn。
examples.translation: Chinese language skills teaching includes listening, speaking, reading and writing.

examples.sentence: 中场休息时间到了，比赛双方队员各自回场外休息。
examples.romanization: zhōngchǎng xiūxi shíjiān dàoliǎo， bǐsài shuāngfāng duìyuán gèzì huí chǎng wài xiūxi。
examples.translation: The intermission time has arrived, and the players on both sides of the game (each by themselves) went back out of the court to rest.

examples.romanization: fēi gōngzuòrényuán， qǐng wù rù nèi。
examples.translation: If you’re not a staff member, please do not enter.

examples.sentence: 在最后时刻，他为本队踢进了关键一球。
examples.romanization: zài zuìhòu shíkè， tā wéi běn duì tī jìn le guānjiàn yī qiú。
examples.translation: At the last moment, he scored the key goal for the team.

title: 时刻，时时刻刻 (at all times)
longExplanation: at all times. Pinyin: shíkè， shíshíkèkè

examples.sentence: 工作中，他时时刻刻提醒自已： 乘客的安全是最重要的。
examples.romanization: gōngzuò zhōng， tā shíshíkèkè tíxǐng zì yǐ： chéngkè de ānquán shì zuì zhòngyào de。
examples.translation: At work, he reminds himself at all times: The safety of passengers is the most important.

examples.sentence: 我在北京出生、长大，至今还没离开过呢。
examples.romanization: wǒ zài Běijīng chūshēng、 zhǎngdà， zhìjīn hái méi líkāi guò ne。
examples.translation: I was born and raised in Beijing and have never left to this day.

examples.romanization: wǒ zhè dǐng xīn màozi zěnmeyàng？
examples.translation: How [what do you think of] this new hat of mine?
Please raise your hand over (the top of) your head.

examples.sentence: 他能用头顶起20斤重的东西。
examples.romanization: tā néng yòng tóudǐng qǐ20 jīn zhòng de dōngxi。
examples.translation: He can use his head to lift 20 pounds.

examples.sentence: 天气非常寒冷，子路顶着大雪往前走。
examples.romanization: tiānqì fēicháng hánlěng， Zǐ Lù dǐng zhe Dàxuě wǎngqián zǒu。
examples.translation: The weather is very cold, and Zilu was trudging ahead against heavy snow.

title: ……得很/得不行/得不得了 (very/so/extremely)
longExplanation: very/so/extremely. Pinyin: …… dehěn/ dé bùxíng/ dé bùdéliǎo

examples.sentence: 这个地方这么热闹，孩子们高兴得很/得不行/得不得了。
examples.romanization: zhège dìfang zhème rènao， háizimen gāoxìng dehěn/ dé bùxíng/ dé bùdéliǎo。
examples.translation: The place is so lively, the children are very/so/extremely happy.
